papers.title: Gemini 1.5: Unlocking Multimodal Understanding Across Millions of Tokens of Context
papers.title_zh: Gemini 1.5：解锁百万级上下文的多模态理解
papers.abstract: We introduce Gemini 1.5, a highly compute-efficient multimodal mixture-of-experts model capable of recalling and reasoning over fine-grained information from millions of tokens of context.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文介绍 Gemini 1.5，一种高计算效率的多模态混合专家模型。该模型能够在数百万词元的上下文中检索并推理细粒度信息，在长文档、长视频和音频理解任务中展现出突破性能力。

papers.title: Mobile ALOHA: Learning Bimanual Mobile Manipulation with Low-Cost Whole-Body Teleoperation
papers.title_zh: Mobile ALOHA：通过低成本全身遥操作学习双臂移动操作
papers.abstract: We present a low-cost whole-body teleoperation system for collecting data on bimanual mobile manipulation and show that co-training with existing static ALOHA datasets increases performance on mobile manipulation tasks.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种低成本全身遥操作系统，用于采集双臂移动操作数据。实验显示，将移动操作数据与已有静态 ALOHA 数据共同训练，可以显著提升机器人执行复杂移动操作任务的成功率。

papers.title: Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models
papers.title_zh: Llama 2：开放基础模型与微调对话模型
papers.abstract: We develop and release Llama 2, a collection of pretrained and fine-tuned large language models ranging in scale from 7 billion to 70 billion parameters, including chat-optimized variants.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文开发并发布 Llama 2 系列预训练与微调大语言模型，参数规模覆盖 70 亿至 700 亿，并包含针对对话场景优化的版本。研究详细描述了微调方法及安全性改进策略。

papers.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
papers.title_zh: ReAct：协同语言模型中的推理与行动
papers.abstract: We explore the use of large language models to generate both reasoning traces and task-specific actions in an interleaved manner, allowing greater synergy between the two and improving interpretability and trustworthiness.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文探索让大语言模型交替生成推理轨迹与任务相关行动，使推理帮助模型制定并调整行动计划，行动则帮助模型从外部环境获取信息，从而提升可解释性、可信度与任务表现。

papers.title: PaLM-E: An Embodied Multimodal Language Model
papers.abstract: We propose embodied language models to directly incorporate continuous inputs from an embodied agent into a language model, thereby establishing the link between words and percepts in the real world.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文提出具身语言模型，将具身智能体的连续传感输入直接融入语言模型，在文字与真实世界感知之间建立联系。PaLM-E 可同时处理机器人规划、视觉问答与语言任务，并展现出正向迁移能力。

papers.title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
papers.title_zh: 使用潜空间扩散模型进行高分辨率图像合成
papers.abstract: By applying diffusion models in the latent space of powerful pretrained autoencoders, we achieve a near-optimal point between complexity reduction and detail preservation, greatly boosting visual fidelity while reducing computational requirements.
papers.abstract_zh: 通过在强大预训练自编码器的潜空间中应用扩散模型，本文在降低复杂度与保留图像细节之间取得良好平衡，显著减少计算需求，同时提升图像合成的视觉保真度。

papers.title: Training Language Models to Follow Instructions with Human Feedback
papers.title_zh: 利用人类反馈训练语言模型遵循指令
papers.abstract: Making language models bigger does not inherently make them better at following a user's intent. We fine-tune GPT-3 using supervised learning and reinforcement learning from human feedback, resulting in models that users prefer despite having fewer parameters.
papers.abstract_zh: 增大语言模型并不会天然提升其遵循用户意图的能力。研究通过监督学习和基于人类反馈的强化学习微调 GPT-3，使参数量更小的模型也能产出更符合用户偏好、更真实且有害输出更少的回答。

papers.title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
papers.title_zh: 一张图像值 16×16 个词：用于大规模图像识别的 Transformer
papers.abstract: We show that a pure transformer applied directly to sequences of image patches can perform very well on image classification tasks. When pre-trained on large amounts of data and transferred to multiple benchmarks, Vision Transformer attains excellent results.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文证明，将纯 Transformer 直接应用于图像块序列，可以在图像分类任务上取得优异表现。Vision Transformer 在大规模数据上预训练并迁移到多个基准后，以明显更少的训练计算获得了极具竞争力的结果。

papers.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
papers.title_zh: 从自然语言监督中学习可迁移视觉模型
papers.abstract: State-of-the-art computer vision systems are trained to predict a fixed set of predetermined object categories. We demonstrate that the simple pre-training task of predicting which caption goes with which image is an efficient and scalable way to learn image representations.
papers.abstract_zh: 传统计算机视觉系统通常只预测预设类别。本文证明，通过判断文本描述与图像是否匹配这一简单预训练任务，可以高效、可扩展地学习视觉表示，并将自然语言作为灵活接口迁移到多种视觉分类任务。

papers.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
papers.title_zh: 语言模型是少样本学习者
papers.abstract: We demonstrate that scaling up language models greatly improves task-agnostic, few-shot performance, sometimes even reaching competitiveness with prior state-of-the-art fine-tuning approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 研究表明，扩大语言模型规模能显著提升与任务无关的少样本学习能力，在部分任务上甚至可以媲美此前最先进的微调方法。GPT-3 在无需梯度更新的情况下，仅通过文本交互完成多类任务。

papers.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
papers.title_zh: BERT：用于语言理解的深度双向 Transformer 预训练
papers.abstract: We introduce a new language representation model called BERT, which stands for Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers. BERT is designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text by jointly conditioning on both left and right context.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文提出语言表示模型 BERT，即基于 Transformer 的双向编码器表示。BERT 通过同时利用左右两侧上下文，在无标注文本上预训练深层双向表示，只需增加一个输出层即可适配多种自然语言处理任务。

papers.title: Attention Is All You Need
papers.abstract: The dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks. We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely.
papers.abstract_zh: 主流序列转换模型通常依赖复杂的循环神经网络或卷积神经网络。本文提出一种仅基于注意力机制的全新简洁架构 Transformer，完全舍弃循环与卷积结构，并在机器翻译任务中展现出更高的并行效率与性能。
